title: "A Table Set in the Text Flow"
shorttitle: "Table scope"

  apaquarto-pdf: default
---

<!--
Outside journal mode a table is set in the text flow, not in a float. A float
is a group, so whatever a table package declares at its start ends with it; in
the flow nothing ended it. kableExtra opens every table it centres with a bare
\centering, which then ran on to the end of the document: every paragraph after
the first such table was set centred.

The float also kept the table's number and title with the table. In the flow
nothing did, so the number and title could be left at the foot of a page with
the table on the next, and a title of two lines could be split between them.

Render from the tests directory:

    quarto render table-in-flow-scope.qmd

The paragraph after the table should be set flush left and indented, like the
one before it.
-->

This paragraph comes before the table and is set like any other.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-centred
#| tbl-cap: "A Table That kableExtra Centres"
#| echo: false
# What kableExtra::kable_styling(position = "center") writes: a bare
# \centering ahead of the tabular.
knitr::asis_output(paste0("\\centering\n", knitr::kable(
  data.frame(x = 1:2, y = c("a", "b")), format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE)))
```

This paragraph comes after the table and should not be centred.
